correctness.rationale: Both graph presentations and all 65,535 candidate masks are exhaustively checked; 808 faces, 375 pairs, 2,736 Hasse incidences and total topological sort establish acyclic Morse reduction. Exact signed reduction of 56 critical 2-cell boundaries against one critical 1-cell yields gcd 2, and elementary CW attaching-map slides give RP2 wedge 55 two-spheres. A separate binary boundary-rank computation on original simplicial complex agrees; calculations are reproducible from embedded actual code.

value.rationale: The two canonical nonisomorphic SRG(16,6,2,2) graphs have their full open-neighborhood integral homotopy types identified and shown equal despite different independence and closed-neighborhood Cech homotopy. Nontrivial 2-torsion and pi1=Z/2 arise from a genuinely computed attaching degree, not from a routine parameter substitution. This supplies a natural exact finite comparative invariant and reference example.
